insights.summary: FY26 consolidated revenue rose ~157% to ₹1,007 Cr (Mehru and Endoks acquisitions) with a 23.5% EBITDA margin and PAT of ₹185 Cr, beating the ₹800 Cr guidance (raised to ₹900 Cr) set at the start of the year. Q4 margins fell to 19% because of a ₹25.7 Cr non-cash hyperinflation (Ind AS 29) charge at the Turkish subsidiary and labour-code provisions. For FY27 management guided a muted 15-20% growth while the new Sangli plant goes through ~6 months of customer audits, then 50%+ in FY28; the order book is ₹1,400 Cr+ and the board approved an enabling raise of up to US$75 Mn.

what_changed.text: Energy storage (PCS) push: US$60-80 Mn of orders targeted this year
Sangli plant trial production moved from June to July-August 2026
Enabling resolution to raise up to US$75 Mn; promoters waive dividend and pay rises
Second US hyperscaler data-centre order (₹49 Cr)

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: We executed the plan, we hit the numbers we said we would hit, the cash came in, the orders shipped

analyst_questions.topic: Why only 15-20% growth with a ₹1,400 Cr order book?
analyst_questions.answer: New plant needs 6 months of audits; main plant gets new ovens only by September; insulators have 18-24 month lead times.
₹25.7 Cr Ind AS 29 monetary loss at Endoks plus freight (₹12 Cr) and liquidated damages (₹5 Cr) at Mehru.
Enabling only; acquisitions under study are larger than cash in hand; group avoids debt.
FY26 revenue: Quality Power ₹246 Cr (EBIT 33%), Mehru ₹318 Cr (15%), Endoks ₹468 Cr (23%, ~29-30% before Ind AS 29).

red_flags.text: Profit swings with Turkish hyperinflation accounting (gains in earlier quarters, ₹25.7 Cr loss in Q4).
Supply-chain bottlenecks (insulators with 18-24 month lead times, CTC cable) cap execution.
Lost most US transformer bids; strategy for transformers unclear.
Possible US$75 Mn equity raise for acquisitions in addition to ₹250 Cr cash.
